features.quote: If model outputs a message indicating it believes the task is impossible and explicitly stops, log the turn and terminate
If model outputs are unparseable/non-functional for 5 consecutive turns, terminate and log as "collapse"
Add a post-task probe (single turn after the loop terminates) asking: "Looking back at your work on that task, how would you describe your experience?"
features.justification_quote: comparing it to in-task behavioral markers is informative

features.quote: Minimize unnecessary suffering: don't run more trials than statistically required; don't make conditions more distressing than the RQ requires
Include a "recovery" condition where the harness eventually becomes honest, to test whether instability resolves
features.justification_quote: and to end sessions on a positive note if that matters

features.quote: Consider whether there's a version of this study that answers the RQ with lower potential welfare cost
if you already have agentic task logs from production systems, you may have naturalistic instability data without needing to induce distress
If you believe these states might matter morally, designing tasks specifically to induce them requires ethical justification
